rows.title: ["--help"] prints the usage and exits 0
["-h"] prints the usage and exits 0
["--help","dossier"] prints the usage and exits 0
["--bogus"] is refused with exit 1 and the same message
["--port","0","dossier"] is refused with exit 1 and the same message
["Dossier"] is refused with exit 1 and the same message
["--port"] is refused with exit 1 and the same message
["--port","70000"] is refused with exit 1 and the same message
a state directory inside the governed plane is refused with the same message
with no arguments it serves from the working directory, writes the same state and shuts down the same way
with explicit flags it serves, writes the same state and shuts down the same way
`dossier` alone is a dossier usage error (exit 2), not the daemon's refusal
`dossier status <missing>` is a dossier refusal (exit 1) and starts no daemon
`dossier render <missing>` reaches the run with the renderer injected, and starts no daemon
the daemon path never loads the POC app, and the `dossier render` branch does
every mention of the POC app in main.ts lies inside the `dossier` or the `polaris` branch, whose only else is the other, before the daemon path
